name: @amykit/plugin-agent-desktop
description: Drives a desktop app through agent-desktop: snapshot its accessibility tree and act on its refs.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it when a proof has to drive a native desktop app. It adds desktop operations a prove scenario can call: read an app's accessibility tree, click or type on a ref, and press a key combination. A click that succeeds only says it was delivered, so a scenario reads a snapshot after it. It needs the agent-desktop CLI on the machine.
